profissional: I'm a software designer in the age of AI. While generative models speed up coding, my role lies in what comes before it: envisioning, structuring, and planning solid systems, guided by Software Engineering best practices.
I believe every project is born from a human need that deserves to be explored, understood, and handled responsibly, since its impact reflects, in the long run, on both the individual and society.
As a developer, I'm committed to constantly evolving my solutions toward a more sustainable and humane future.
pessoal: I overthink things, and sometimes that pays off. I'm critical, I have good ideas now and then, and I take in a lot from what I consume. I love the art that lives in music, films, games and books. More than that, I love nature, travel and landscapes: the things that remind me life isn't only routine.

I value my friendships deeply, even though some days I'm terrible at being social. I try to be level headed, funny, thoughtful, and sometimes I even try to be someone I'm not. But I always come back to myself.
